The '''''Lucid Voice''''' was a modified [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] that saw service with the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The vessel was [[Color/Legends|colored]] a medium blue, with subtle red bow stripes.

==History==
The ''Lucid Voice'' was a sister ship to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], and&mdash;along with the ''[[Colicoid Swarm]]''&mdash;was used to intimidate [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] that were loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] into surrendering. With the ''Voice''{{'s}} blue coloring, the ship was similar enough to the ''Hand'' in all but its bow striping&mdash;which was different from the ''Hand''{{'s}} yellow markings. This led victimized worlds into believing that they were being attacked by the ''Invisible Hand''&mdash;and therefore Grievous himself.
